name: Decorative radial spotlight glow
description: An accent-colored radial gradient fading to transparent, dropped behind a hero or section as a "spotlight" and bright enough against that surface to read as a cloud floating over the copy. It is a reflex AI decoration ÔÇö the translucent cousin of the saturated radial halo. Let the surface stand on its own, or light the composition with a deliberate material accent rather than a floating colored haze.

name: Auto-scrolling marquee
description: Continuously auto-scrolling content demands attention it has not earned and hides half its content at any moment. Reserve motion for content that changes; let readers move at their own pace.

name: Radial-gradient background halo
description: A chromatic radial-gradient wash ÔÇö saturated at the center, fading to transparent ÔÇö used as a decorative background glow on a dark page. Same tell as glowing shadows, drawn with a gradient instead of a shadow. Ground the surface with a solid or subtly shifted background instead.
snippet: radial-gradient halo (#d9741c ÔåÆ transparent) on dark page

name: Heading crowded against the previous block
description: A heading binds to the content it introduces, so the rendered space above it should exceed the space below it. When headings across a page sit as close or closer to the block above than to their own content, every section reads as if it captions the previous one. Open up the space above each heading.
snippet: h3 "gastronomia" has 0px above vs 16px below ÔÇö it reads as bound to the block above (3 headings on page)
